lines.t: Verse 1
I’m tired of standing on my own feet
They tremble under everything I keep
Every shadow whispers I’m not free
This flesh is just a weight that’s killing me
I chased my will down broken roads
Built my throne out of heavy stones
But every crown I tried to wear
Just pressed me deeper in despair
Pre-Chorus
I hear the noise, it never sleeps
It drowns the truth You speak to me
Chorus
So I raise a white flag heart tonight
Lay down my will, my wrong, my right
Break me open, strip my pride
I don’t wanna live this life inside
Take the dark that’s closing in
I’m suffocating in this world of sin
Let Your voice be all I hear
Make this broken soul sincere
Make this broken soul sincere
Verse 2
I’m sick of fighting what I am
This war inside I never win
Every desire just pulls me down
Till I’m buried underneath the ground
The world is loud, it screams my name
But every promise feels the same
Empty hands and hollow breath
A slow surrender into death
Pre-Chorus
I want Your whisper, nothing more
Just close the noise, and lock the door
Chorus
So I raise a white flag heart tonight
Lay down my will, my wrong, my right
Break me open, strip my pride
I don’t wanna live this life inside
Take the dark that’s closing in
I’m suffocating in this world of sin
Let Your voice be all I hear
Make this broken soul sincere
Bridge
Erase the memory of this place
Every stain, every trace
I don’t wanna know this world
Just Your love, Your light unfurled
Let me forget the lies I’ve known
Be my truth, and You alone
If I’m nothing, let it be
So You are everything in me
Break (soft)
I give up… I give in…
Let Your life begin again…
Final Chorus
Here’s my white flag, torn apart
Take the ruins of my heart
I am Yours, completely Yours
Close every other open door
Fill the void I can’t outrun
Be the light, my only sun
Let me fade so You remain
Only You inside my veins
Outro
No more me… no more fight…
Only You… only light…
